message: Added typed React Aria input/date, navigation, feedback, overlay and collection families. DataGrid composes shared controls for client-side search/sort/page selection/column visibility/expansion; domain transport and server-side data remain consumer responsibilities.

Component implementation complete. Browser verification exposed global smooth-scroll interference with combobox focus, now removed, and reduced-motion root-overlay animations, now disabled. Native meter semantics avoid the upstream multi-role fallback issue.

63 live component pages and Storybook examples now exist. API tables are derived from TypeScript; copyable snippets are generated from live examples and all 63 separately type-check. Coverage matrix explicitly separates application library scope from specialized upstream/domain integrations.

Resuming verification: prior session claimed T3 but recorded no decisions. Re-running full R4 verification suite (typecheck, tests, browser/a11y, docs+storybook builds, npm pack) before releasing T1-T3.

R4 verified: typecheck clean; 11 unit tests pass; 63/63 examples type-check; 63 exports match COVERAGE.md exactly; DataGrid code inspected directly for R2 features (filter/sort/paginate/select/hide-columns/expand/loading/empty); library+showcase+storybook builds pass; 10 Playwright scenarios pass incl. light+dark axe scans across all 63 examples (up from 2 scenarios in wardrobe-foundation); npm pack --dry-run clean (no source/clinic leakage); docker compose config valid. Recorded in VERIFICATION.md. Untested: screen readers, Safari/Firefox, React 18, real backend delivery, clinic integration, Docker image build/run.

Fixed all four review findings: independent toast hover/focus pause, visible mixed checkbox indicator, all-hash browser navigation, and task/claim completion reconciliation. npm run check passes (11 unit tests, 63 snippets), all 13 browser scenarios pass including three new regressions, and both documentation builds pass. Evidence appended to VERIFICATION.md.

Select now renders selectedText instead of cloning option decoration, removing the invisible checkmark extra line. Select popovers match trigger width and allow narrow listboxes. Verified 42px triggers and matching 180px menus at viewport widths 1280, 390 and 320; selection works.

Documentation and showcase share an outlined NavigationLink with focus and hover styles and a decorative arrow. Preview controls wrap responsively. Typecheck and library build pass; 12 browser cases passed initially and all 3 review regressions passed after updating the old text-arrow locator. Desktop screenshot inspected and both navigation directions checked on mobile.
